title: Trend chart
summary: A daily bar chart of new rows in any table, with the change against the period before.
description: A custom component you can drop on any page: it counts the rows of one table per day over the last 7 to 90 days and draws them as bars in your app's colours, with the percentage change between the first and second half of the window. The template adds it with a Trends page for the role you choose; place it on other pages with a custom node.

params.name: entity
params.label: Table to chart
params.description: The table whose new rows the chart counts.

params.name: page_role
params.label: Who sees the Trends page
params.description: The role the Trends page is for.
